maxRps.rationale: Prose describes a load balancer in front of the API but gives no specific admission ceiling, so use a large typical gateway limit well above the current 10k rps.

instances.rationale: Prose states the API layer currently runs 20 instances behind the load balancer.

concurrencyPerInstance.rationale: No concurrency figure given; typical concurrency for a stateless, I/O-bound redirect/lookup service instance.

serviceTimeMs.rationale: No timing given; redirect and short-link-creation handling logic itself (excluding cache/DB wait) is lightweight.

hitRate.rationale: Prose says most traffic is for recently-shortened links and the cache 'should absorb a good chunk' of it, implying a high but not extreme hit rate.

hitLatencyMs.rationale: No latency given; typical in-memory Redis GET latency.

ttlSeconds.rationale: Prose states the Redis cache uses a five-minute TTL.

keyspaceHotSet.rationale: No hot-key count given; typical distinct-key working set for a recently-shortened-links cache at this traffic level.

connectionPoolSize.rationale: Prose states the Postgres connection pool is capped at 100 connections.

queryTimeMs.rationale: No query timing given; typical mean latency for indexed lookup/insert queries on Postgres.

writeRatio.rationale: Prose says creating new short links happens rarely compared to the vast majority of redirect (read) traffic, so writes are a small share.

readReplicas.rationale: Prose explicitly states no read replicas are run.

replicaApplyRate.rationale: With zero read replicas stated, there is no replica apply throughput to speak of.
